title: ZEW
desc: A wordmark with a second meaning hidden inside it

blocks.title: ZEW
blocks.lede: A wordmark with a second meaning hidden inside it.

items.label: Role
items.value: Naming, logotype, identity design, art direction

items.label: Scope
items.value: Naming, mark, identity system, print, in-venue applications

items.statement: ZEW had two personalities to reconcile.
body: One was raw and primal. The other was refined and contemporary.
The early directions leaned too far one way or the other, so the identity needed to hold both without falling into restaurant clichés.

items.statement: Make the mark do more than one job.
body: At first glance, ZEW is simply a confident geometric wordmark. Look closer and the dot and horizontal stroke within the E form the silhouette of a cloche.

blocks.text: The best logo trick is the one you discover yourself.

body: The hidden construction became part of a wider identity system across menus, signage, takeaway packaging and in-venue applications.
The visual language stays restrained so the mark, typography and material feel can carry the personality.

blocks.statement: Strong from a distance. Rewarding up close. That tension is the identity.
body: One identity works from menu scale to venue scale without needing a separate “small” and “large” solution.
